description: Who holds this issuer on Form 13F for one period (newest by default). By default one record per manager, ranked by shares, with the manager's filing link and the number of rows behind each total, so "who holds the most" is one call (limit=10 for a top ten). view=positions returns the raw 13F rows instead; sort=value ranks by checked value. Options and convertible principal are kept apart from shares; amendments are resolved so a manager is not counted twice; a value that a filing's own evidence cannot settle is left out and flagged, never guessed. Managers are filers: related filers (two Vanguard entities) stay separate, and shares of different managers are never added together. About 35% of 13F rows lack dual-evidence CIK links and are left out. An empty list explains itself in meta.empty_reason; SEC publishes the 13F data sets in three-month windows, so the newest quarter is not there until its window closes. Costs 3 credits. A figure can be withheld (null/absent beats a guess). A figure can change or disappear when a later filing arrives; figures are not versioned. Read `adjustments` for extractor decisions beyond copying one filed figure. This is filing data, not investment advice.
